angle: level, lens on the water surface
start_frame: The same water-level medium held: Alice treading water, warm broken lamplight on the surface behind her, her cornflower blue the only colour left in the frame.
end_frame: The same frame at the end of both lines, with air between them: she has looked round at the flooded hall and said what she supposes will happen to her, and nothing in the shot has moved but the water.
constraint_honoured: 'Both lines whole in one shot with air between them.'
movement_note: LN-ep01-030 (2.1 s) and LN-030b (5.6 s) both land whole inside 9.5 s of unmoving frame; a move would compete with the silence the pair needs between them.
